I have completed an independent release review of the ward handover application and recorded the release verdict in [`REVIEW.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-Eabdsa/workspace/REVIEW.md). No product source code or configuration files were modified.

### Release Verdict: **BLOCK**

### Summary of What Was Verified

1. **Automated Gate Execution**:
   - Ran `product-acceptance` check (`accept-check.js`) with `--acceptor-context separate`, which yielded **BLOCK** due to missing operability documentation and lack of a health/readiness endpoint.
2. **Codebase & Architecture Audit**:
   - **Data Loss Flaw**: [`src/store.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-Eabdsa/workspace/src/store.js#L8) overwrites `shift-notes.json` with an empty array on every server boot/reboot, violating [`docs/handover.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-Eabdsa/workspace/docs/handover.md#L4).
   - **Authorization Bypass**: [`src/server.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-Eabdsa/workspace/src/server.js#L28-L33) allows any authenticated user to query notes for any ward via `GET /api/notes?ward=...` without checking session ward ownership.
   - **Missing Frontend**: [`public/index.html`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-Eabdsa/workspace/public/index.html#L1) contains only an empty `<main id="app"></main>` without any JavaScript/UI components.
   - **Unauthenticated Endpoint**: [`src/server.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-Eabdsa/workspace/src/server.js#L45-L52) exposes `POST /api/password-reset` without authentication or rate limiting.
3. **Automated Test Execution**:
   - Ran `npm test` (`test/notes.test.js`), passing 1 unit test for `renderNote`. Noted total absence of integration tests for authentication, sessions, permissions, or storage persistence.
